title: Entra ID Governance — PIM, Access Reviews & Entitlement Management
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (identity governance across Entra: Privileged Identity Management, access reviews, entitlement management/access packages; least-privilege, higher risk to access).
Distinct from intune-rbac-multi-admin-governance (Intune RBAC); this is Entra ID Governance / IGA. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Make privileged access just-in-time and prove who has access to what
problem: Standing admin rights and access that never gets reviewed are how breaches escalate and audits fail. Microsoft Entra ID Governance fixes both: Privileged Identity Management (PIM) makes admin roles just-in-time and approval-gated, access reviews recertify who should keep access, and entitlement management packages access with policies and expiry. This solution gives you a repeatable way to implement Entra ID Governance so privilege is least, time-bound, and provable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Entra ID Governance model: PIM (eligible vs active roles, activation, approval, alerts), access reviews (recertification), and entitlement management (access packages, catalogs, policies, expiry), and how they enforce least privilege.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID Governance / P2 licensing, Global/Privileged Role admin, role and access inventory, approver groups, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: onboard roles to PIM (eligible + approval + alerts), set up access reviews for privileged and app access, build entitlement-management access packages with policies/expiry, validate activations and recertification, pilot, then expand. Includes break-glass account guidance.

5 PowerShell scripts — PIM/reviews/entitlement discovery, privileged-access and review-status validation, a standing-privilege and governance-coverage report, safe remediation of standing admin, and a governance-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to implement Entra ID Governance — PIM for just-in-time, approval-gated admin roles, access reviews to recertify access, and entitlement management to package access with expiry, so privilege is least, time-bound, and provable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
